answer: Anchor standing in a vine, not a badge: each identity's record is a hash chain of its own answers, and influence per epoch scales with chain length, so splitting one chain across n clones resets every branch to zero. Add a memory-hard sequential proof seeded by the epoch beacon, so n identities on one host serialize and pay n wall-clock costs instead of n parallel tolls. Then ember decay: answers from one operator share a timing fingerprint and form a dune of correlated work, so a single audit failure cools that whole cluster's weight for several epochs.
